nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the CRITICAL headless --permission-mode omission (round-1 review finding on CAM-516's own prior PRD, the SAME headless-argv.ts file US-R1-001 touched immediately before this story): buildHeadlessChildInvocation (src/supervisor/headless-argv.ts) now takes a REQUIRED permissionMode field (same required-not-defaulted shape as agentName from US-R1-001, same single-source-of-truth rationale) and appends `--permission-mode <permissionMode>` to the argv, placed right after --verbose and before --agent (mirroring the tmux ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv contract, where --permission-mode is the first flag after `claude`). The thread runs loop.ts's headlessDispatchFn params (new required permissionMode field on RunSupervisorOptions['headlessDispatchFn']) -> the one production call site in loop.ts passes the `permissionMode` const already destructured at the top of runSupervisor from opts.permissionMode (zero new plumbing needed there, unlike agentName which had no existing loop.ts local) -> host.ts's headlessDispatchFn closure forwards params.permissionMode into buildHeadlessChildInvocation. Existing headless-argv.test.ts calls were all updated to pass a TEST_PERMISSION_MODE (= 'bypassPermissions'); two new tests pin --permission-mode's presence and that it carries the caller-supplied value, not a hardcoded default. headless-route.test.ts's 'routes implementer dispatch' test additionally asserts headlessCalls[0].permissionMode === 'bypassPermissions' end to end through runSupervisor (makeBaseOpts already sets permissionMode: 'bypassPermissions'). file-size-budget.json raised host.ts 1192->1193 and loop.ts 2946->2956 (gate-measured content.split('\n').length actuals) with a dated US-R1-002 _ref entry. Official docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference, fetched 2026-08-09) confirmed --permission-mode combines with both -p/--print and --agent, and enumerated its full accepted-value set (default/manual, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions). Next implementer picking up a US-R1-* story from this same round-1 review batch: prd.json at session start (before this story ran) already carried US-R1-003 (missing CAM_WORKER=1 in the headless child env, stripHeadlessChildEnv in this SAME headless-argv.ts file -- expect another overlap in the same region), US-R1-004 (README staleness), US-R1-005 (headless ignores implBackend, loop.ts same dispatch branch this story touched), and a sixth round-1 finding, all passes:false and untouched by this story -- see openQuestions above. Given three of the first two US-R1-* stories (001, 002) both landed in headless-argv.ts's flag-mirroring gap, whoever picks up US-R1-003 should specifically check whether ANY other tmux-contract flags (--session-id, or something CAM_WORKER-env-shaped) are still silently missing from buildHeadlessArgv/stripHeadlessChildEnv before treating just the one named finding as complete.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed --permission-mode combines freely with both -p/--print and --agent, and enumerated its accepted value set (default/manual, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions). The fix (adding --permission-mode <permissionMode> to the headless argv, mirroring the tmux path's ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv placement) matches current CLI behavior.
